+# Private-code delivery
+
+Use [`examples/px1-review-private.yml`](../examples/px1-review-private.yml) for
+repositories whose source should not be published through a public GitHub Pages
+site. The workflow uploads the static bundle as a GitHub Actions artifact and
+links it from the pull request.
+
+The download requires a signed-in GitHub user with read access to the repository,
+as described in GitHub's [artifact download documentation](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/how-tos/manage-workflow-runs/download-workflow-artifacts).
+The example retains each artifact for 30 days. After downloading and unzipping
+the artifact, open `index.html`; it makes no network requests.
+
+## Privacy check
+
+The reusable Action runs `px1 privacy-check` by default. It blocks delivery when
+the generated report contains a high-confidence secret signature or a changed
+path commonly used for credentials, such as `.env`, a private key, or a package
+manager credentials file. Findings name the signature or path but never print
+the detected value.
+
+This bounded check can miss secrets and can produce false positives. It does not
+remove content, redact values, or grant access control. Fix or remove sensitive
+material before delivery. `privacy-check: false` exists for reviewed false
+positives and emits a warning; it must not be treated as a safe-publication flag.
+
+## Model transfer
+
+AI explanations are off unless `explanation-model` is set. Enabling them sends
+bounded, non-excluded pull-request diff content to the configured model endpoint.
+The Action warns before transfer. `explanation-exclude-globs` reduces the paths
+sent to the model, but it is not redaction and excluded files still appear in
+the report bundle.
+
+## Integrity
+
+Every bundle contains `checksums.sha256` for `index.html` and `review.json`.
+GitHub's uploaded archive also has an artifact digest shown in the private
+workflow's PR comment. These hashes can detect changed bytes; they do not prove
+who generated or approved the report.
+
+## Public Pages
+
+The Pages template remains available for repositories that deliberately choose
+that delivery model. Confirm the site's effective visibility before enabling it:
+a private source repository does not by itself guarantee a private Pages site.
+GitHub documents the applicable [Pages visibility and access-control behavior](https://docs.github.com/en/enterprise-cloud@latest/pages/getting-started-with-github-pages/changing-the-visibility-of-your-github-pages-site).

+        with:
+          script: |
+            const fs = require('fs');
+            const runs = await github.paginate(github.rest.checks.listForRef, {
+              owner: context.repo.owner,
+              repo: context.repo.repo,
+              ref: process.env.HEAD_SHA,
+              per_page: 100,
+            });
+            const names = new Map();
+            const checks = runs.map((run) => {
+              const baseName = run.name || run.app?.name || 'GitHub check';
+              const count = (names.get(baseName) || 0) + 1;
+              names.set(baseName, count);
+              const name = count === 1 ? baseName : `${baseName} (${count})`;
+              let status = 'cancelled';
+              if (run.status === 'queued') status = 'queued';
+              else if (run.status !== 'completed') status = 'running';
+              else if (run.conclusion === 'success' || run.conclusion === 'neutral') status = 'passed';
+              else if (['failure', 'timed_out', 'action_required'].includes(run.conclusion)) status = 'failed';
+              return {

+                status,

+                url: run.html_url || '',

+                finishedAt: run.completed_at || undefined,

explanations.summary: The workflow still prefers `OPENAI_API_KEY` but also accepts the existing `OPENAI_API__KEY` secret, allowing explanations to keep working while the secret is renamed.

explanations.title: Add scoped code-writing rules
explanations.summary: The repository adds language-scoped conventions for JavaScript, TypeScript, and Go, including strict equality, non-empty error handling, and avoiding async callbacks with `forEach`. Matching changes can now produce repository-policy findings.

explanations.title: Warn before sending diff content to a model
explanations.summary: When AI explanations are enabled, the workflow emits a warning before sending bounded, non-excluded diff content to the configured model endpoint.

explanations.title: Block reports that match privacy risks
explanations.summary: The Action now runs a privacy check before delivery by default and stops if it finds likely secrets or sensitive paths. Setting `privacy-check: false` skips the scan but emits a warning; the scan does not redact the report.

explanations.title: Add access-controlled report delivery
explanations.summary: The private workflow uploads the report as a 30-day GitHub Actions artifact and links to it in the PR comment, instead of publishing it through Pages. Downloading requires repository read access.

explanations.title: Add checksums to report bundles
explanations.summary: Each generated bundle now includes SHA-256 checksums for `index.html` and `review.json`, so later steps can detect changed report files.

explanations.title: Limit inspection questions to changed files
explanations.summary: Inspection questions no longer use scans of unchanged files to suggest related tests. Questions are based on changed files and their companion tests in the diff.

explanations.title: Detect common secret signatures and paths
explanations.summary: The check looks for several common credential paths and high-confidence token or private-key signatures in the generated report. It reports the type of risk without printing detected secret values.

explanations.title: Verify checksums in report history
explanations.summary: The history script now accepts checksum manifests and verifies them when validating and restoring Pages reports. A report with invalid checksums is rejected.

explanations.title: Add persistent sidebar text sizing
explanations.summary: Reviewers can resize sidebar text using the new controls. The selected size is stored in browser storage and restored for later visits.

explanations.title: Remove local feedback exports
explanations.summary: The report no longer provides a reviewer-notes field or Markdown/JSON feedback export; the sidebar now ends with findings and the changed-file list.
